              Result = sprintf("n = %s, p %s", n_fmt(n), pv(dclf_p)),
              Verdict = "unchanged, not an edge effect"),
  tibble(Check = "Renormalisation (N2)",
         Variant = paste0("normpower = ", SO$np_check$normpower),
         Result = sprintf("L(2 km) = %s", n_fmt(round(SO$np_check$L_at_2000))),
         Verdict = "same sign and shape"),
  tibble(Check = "Parametric nulls",
         Variant = c("N4 log-linear trend", "N4b flexible trend",
                     "N5 trend + Thomas"),
         Result = c(sprintf("p %s", pv(VA$gof_M1_test$p.value)),
                    sprintf("p %s", pv(VA$gof_M2_test$p.value)),
                    sprintf("p %.2f", VA$gof_M3_test$p.value)),
         Verdict = c("rejects null", "rejects null", "**fits**")),
  tibble(Check = "Space–time (N3)",
         Variant = sprintf("%s km / ≤%s d", SO$knox_res$space_m/1000,
                           SO$knox_res$time_d),
         Result = sprintf("ratio %.2f, p %s", SO$knox_res$ratio,
                          pv(SO$knox_res$p_value)),
         Verdict = ifelse(SO$knox_res$p_value < 0.05, "rejects null",
                          "cannot reject"))
) |>
  gt::gt(groupname_col = "Check") |>
  gt::fmt_markdown(columns = Verdict) |>
  gt::tab_options(table.font.size = gt::pct(80), data_row.padding = gt::px(4),
                  row_group.font.weight = "bold")

Two things are stable, and one is not.

Stable. The parametric verdict (geography-driven Poisson rejected, trend-plus-clustering accepted) and the space–time verdict. Neither depends on a bandwidth. The N2 non-result is also stable across event definitions, windows and normalisations, which confirms it is a property of the test rather than of any incidental choice.

Not stable. The N2 verdict across \(\sigma_\lambda\), by design. Reporting a single \(\sigma_\lambda\) would have produced a confident conclusion in either direction depending on which value was chosen, which is precisely why the ladder is shown.

The first-order findings are less robust than either, and the report says so: absolute intensities are lower bounds because of cloud, and the day-to-day profile is observation-driven.

两件事是稳定的,一件不是。

稳定的。 参数化的判定(地理驱动的泊松被拒绝、趋势加聚集被接受)以及 时空判定。两者都不依赖带宽。N2 的「非结果」在不同事件定义、窗口与归一化方式下 也同样稳定,这印证了它是检验本身的性质,而不是某个偶然选择的性质。

不稳定的。 N2 在不同 \(\sigma_\lambda\) 下的判定,而这是刻意设计的。若只 报告单一 \(\sigma_\lambda\),就会得出一个自信的结论,而结论方向完全取决于选了哪个 取值。这正是要展示整个带宽阶梯的原因。

一阶发现的稳健性比这两者都低,报告也如实说明:由于云的存在,绝对强度只是下界, 而逐日轮廓是由观测驱动的。

8.4 Alternative explanations替代解释

Four alternatives could produce the observed structure without fire-to-fire interaction, and each is assessed on its merits.

1. Sensor artefacts. A single burning area spans several 375 m pixels, which would appear as a cluster. Assessment: addressed by construction. The pixel-day unit removes same-day repeat overpasses and the event unit removes spatial extent entirely; the N2 result is identical across all three (§ 6.5), and no result below ~500 m is interpreted anywhere.

2. An omitted covariate. If land cover, peat depth or tenure varies at a few kilometres and drives fire, the “clustering” in M3 is unmodelled first-order variation. Assessment: this cannot be excluded, and it is the most serious alternative. It is the identifiability problem in applied form. What N4 establishes is that the geography we measured does not explain the pattern, not that no geography could. The Thomas process should therefore be read as a compact description of a few-kilometre correlation structure, not as evidence that ignitions physically propagate.

3. Multi-day smouldering. Peat fires burn for days, so a location recurring on consecutive days creates space–time dependence without new ignition. Assessment: real and quantitatively relevant, 30% of pixels were detected on more than one day (§ 3.5). It inflates the Knox result at lags ≥ 1 and cannot be separated from spread with these data. It does not explain the lag-0 excess (1.52× within 1 km on the same day), which involves distinct locations.

4. Correlated observation. Cloud clears in patches, so detections could cluster because detection clusters. Assessment: independent thinning leaves the pair-correlation function unchanged (A. Baddeley et al., 2015), but cloud is not independent thinning: a cloud-hole a few kilometres across would mimic a fire cluster a few kilometres across. Partial reassurance comes from the three-satellite comparison (they pass at different times and so see different cloud fields), but this is not a complete control, and it applies to the Thomas cluster scale as much as to the intensity surface.

有四种替代解释可以在不存在火与火之间交互的情况下产生观测到的结构,以下逐一 按其实际分量评估。

1. 传感器假象。 一片燃烧区域横跨若干 375 m 像元,看起来就像一个簇。评估: 已由构造方式解决。像元-日单元剔除了同日重复过境,事件单元则完全剔除了空间范围; 而 N2 结果在三种单元下完全一致(§ 6.5),并且报告中任何低于约 500 m 的结果都未被解读。

2. 遗漏的协变量。 如果土地覆盖、泥炭深度或土地权属在数公里尺度上变化并驱动火, 那么 M3 中的「聚集」其实是未建模的一阶变化。评估: 这一点无法排除,而且它是 最严重的替代解释。 它就是可识别性问题的应用版形态。N4 所确立的是我们所测得的 地理条件无法解释该模式,而不是「没有任何地理条件能解释」。因此 Thomas 过程应被 读作对一个数公里相关结构的紧凑描述,而不是点火在物理上传播的证据。

3. 跨日阴燃。 泥炭火会烧数天,因此同一位置在连续几天复现,就会在没有新点火的 情况下造成时空依赖。评估: 真实存在且在量上相关, 30% 的像元被探测到超过一天 (§ 3.5)。它会抬高滞后 ≥ 1 的 Knox 结果,而用这些数据无法把它与蔓延分开。 但它无法解释滞后 0 的超额(1 km 内同日为 1.52×), 因为那涉及的是不同的位置。

4. 相关的观测过程。 云是成片放晴的,因此探测可能因为探测本身成簇而成簇。 评估: 独立抽稀不改变对相关函数 (A. Baddeley et al., 2015),但云不是独立抽稀:一个数公里宽 的云洞会伪装成一个数公里宽的火簇。三卫星比较提供了部分安慰(它们过境时刻不同, 因此看到的是不同的云场)但这不是完整的对照,而且这一点对 Thomas 簇群尺度的 威胁与对强度面的威胁同样大。

8.5 What would change these conclusions什么会改变这些结论

  • A full season of data would settle whether the September concentration is persistent or episodic, and would give the N2 test far more power by allowing intensity to be estimated from a longer record than the one being tested. This is a one-line change to the acquisition call.
  • Peat depth, water-table and land-cover data would test alternative 2 directly, and would convert the canal proximity proxy into a measured mechanism.
  • A cloud-mask time series would let the observation process be modelled as a known thinning rather than treated as an unquantified bias, the single largest improvement available to the first-order analysis, and the only way to address alternative 4 properly.
  • A directional second-order analysis would test whether the clustering is aligned with the canal grid, which the isotropic functions used here cannot see.
  • 一整个火季的数据能够判定 9 月的这种集中是持续性的还是偶发性的,并且能让 强度从一段比被检验对象更长的记录中估计,从而大幅提升 N2 检验的检验力。这只需要 改动获取脚本调用的一行。
  • 泥炭深度、地下水位与土地覆盖数据能够直接检验替代解释 2,并把「运河邻近度」 这个代理变量转化为一个被实际测量的机制。
  • 云掩膜时间序列能让观测过程被建模为一个已知的抽稀,而不是被当作未量化的 偏差处理。这是一阶分析可获得的最大改进,也是正确处理替代解释 4 的唯一途径。
  • 方向性(各向异性)二阶分析能检验聚集是否与运河格网对齐,而本报告所用的各向 同性函数看不到这一点。

9 Geovisualisation and geocommunication地理可视化与地理传达

The interpretation of each individual figure appears beside that figure, in the section where its analysis is carried out. This section states the decisions that are shared across all of them, what each family of graphic is for, how quantities are encoded, and what the encoding cannot be asked to do. The reasoning is set out once here instead of being repeated twenty-one times.

每一幅图的具体解读,都紧贴该图放在它所属的分析章节里。这里陈述的是跨越所有图形 的共同决策,每一类图形各自承担什么任务、数量如何被编码,以及这套编码不能 被要求做到什么。把这些理由集中写在这里,好过重复二十一次。

9.1 Four families of graphic, four jobs四类图形,四项任务

The report uses a deliberately small vocabulary. Every graphic belongs to one of four families, and each family answers one kind of question.

Maps answer where. They carry the intensity surface (Fig. 8), the district aggregation (Fig. 9), the study window and its context (Fig. 1), and the model residuals (Fig. 21). All are drawn in EPSG:32749, the projection in which the analysis itself is done, so that a distance read off a map is the distance the statistics used, the projected area error is 0.26%, reported in § 3.8.

Envelope plots answer compared with what. Every second-order figure (Fig. 14, Fig. 15, Fig. 17, Fig. 20) plots an observed curve against a simulated envelope, never against a theoretical line alone, because the report’s central claim is about reference models, not about statistics. The curves are centred on the null expectation so that the deviation (not the absolute value) is what the reader’s eye measures.

Covariate curves answer along what gradient. Fig. 11 and Fig. 10 express intensity as a function of distance instead of as a colour on a map, because a monotone decline is legible in a line and invisible in a fill.

Small multiples answer how much does this depend on my choice. The bandwidth ladder (Fig. 7), the null-model ladder (Fig. 15) and the Knox threshold grid (Fig. 18) each show the same estimate repeated across the parameter that was chosen, so that sensitivity is shown, not asserted.

图形词汇是刻意压缩过的。每一幅图都属于以下四类之一,而每一类回答一种 问题。

地图回答在哪里。它们承载强度面(Fig. 8)、按区聚合 (Fig. 9)、研究窗口及其背景(Fig. 1),以及模型残差 (Fig. 21)。全部绘制于 EPSG:32749(也就是分析本身所用的投影)因此从地图上量 得的距离,就是统计量所使用的距离;投影面积误差为 0.26%,详见 § 3.8。

包络图回答与什么相比。每一幅二阶图形(Fig. 14、Fig. 15、Fig. 17、 Fig. 20)都是把观测曲线与模拟包络对照,而不是仅仅对照一条理论线,因为本报告的 核心论断是关于参照模型的,不是关于统计量的。曲线以零模型期望为中心,使读者的 眼睛度量的是偏离,而不是绝对值。

协变量曲线回答沿着什么梯度。Fig. 11 与 Fig. 10 把强度表达为距离 的函数,而不是地图上的一种颜色,因为单调下降在折线中一目了然,在色块填充中则不可见。

小倍数图回答这有多依赖我的选择。带宽阶梯(Fig. 7)、零模型阶梯 (Fig. 15)与 Knox 阈值网格(Fig. 18),都是把同一个估计沿着被选定的那个 参数重复呈现,从而把敏感性展示出来,而不是仅仅断言。

9.2 What the colours mean颜色的含义

Colour carries meaning in this report, and it carries only one.

Warm hues are reserved for quantities that actually represent fire. The sequential ramp used for every density surface runs through seven stops from #fffbf5 to #6b0d05, and its lightness decreases monotonically along that sequence. Two consequences follow, and both were the reason for building the ramp by hand instead of accepting a default: the order of the classes survives greyscale printing, and it survives the common forms of colour-vision deficiency, because the reader is decoding lightness rather than hue.

Teal (#0e7490) is the cool counterweight and is used only for quantities that are deliberately not fire, rivers, and the “distance to natural water” covariate whose effect runs opposite to the canal effect. Structure (windows, boundaries, gridlines, envelopes) stays in neutral greys, so that the page furniture never competes with the data for attention. No figure in the report encodes a variable in red against green.

Categorical encodings are always declared explicitly, never left to the default palette, which is why scale_*_manual appears throughout the analysis chunks: a category’s colour is part of the argument and should not change when a factor level is added.

颜色在本报告中承载意义,而且只承载一种意义。

暖色专门保留给真正代表火的量。所有密度面所用的顺序色带,由 #fffbf5 到 #6b0d05 共七级,其亮度沿序列单调下降。由此得到两个后果,而这两点正是手工构造 这条色带、而非沿用默认值的原因:类别的顺序在灰度打印下依然成立,在常见的色觉 缺陷下也依然成立,因为读者解码的是亮度,而不是色相。

青色(#0e7490)是冷色的对位,只用于那些刻意不是火的量(河流,以及「到天然 水体的距离」这一效应方向与运河相反的协变量。结构性元素)窗口、边界、网格线、 包络,一律保持中性灰,使页面构件永远不与数据争夺注意力。报告中没有任何一幅图 用红对绿来编码变量。

分类型编码一律显式声明,而不交给默认调色板。这也是分析代码块中处处出现 scale_*_manual 的原因:一个类别的颜色是论证的一部分,不应在新增一个因子水平时 发生改变。

9.3 What the figures cannot be asked to do这些图形不能被要求做到什么

Three limits are worth stating, because each of them is a place where a reader could over-read a picture.

A density surface is a smoothed quantity, and the smoothing bandwidth is an analytical choice, not a property of the fire. Fig. 8 is drawn at \(\sigma = 2\) km; Fig. 7 exists precisely so that the reader can see how much of the apparent structure belongs to the kernel and not to the field. No conclusion in this report rests on a feature visible at only one bandwidth.

A map of detections is a map of the observation process multiplied by the fire field, as § 4 sets out. Bright areas on any intensity map are places where fire was detected often, which is not the same as places where fire burned most. Cloud cover and overpass geometry are part of what the colour is showing.

Figure text is not switched by the EN / 中文 control. Titles, subtitles and axis labels are drawn into the image by R at render time and cannot be translated in the browser, so they remain in English in both language modes. Every hand-written element around the figures (captions, interpretations, and the alternative text that screen readers receive) is bilingual.

有三条限度值得明确写出,因为每一条都是读者可能过度解读一幅图的地方。

密度面是一个经过平滑的量,而平滑带宽是一项分析选择,不是火本身的属性。 Fig. 8 绘制于 \(\sigma = 2\) km;Fig. 7 的存在正是为了让读者看清:表观 结构中有多少来自核函数,而非来自火场。本报告没有任何结论建立在只在单一带宽下 才可见的特征上。

一幅探测点地图,是观测过程与火场相乘的结果,如 § 4 所述。任何强度 图上的明亮区域,是火被探测到得更频繁的地方,这与火烧得最多的地方并不相同; 云覆盖与过境几何也是那种颜色所呈现内容的一部分。

图形内部的文字不随 EN / 中文 切换。 标题、副标题与坐标轴标签由 R 在渲染时画入 图像,无法在浏览器端翻译,因此在两种语言模式下都保持英文。图形周围一切手写元素(题注、解读,以及屏幕阅读器读到的替代文本)都是双语的。

10 Public-safety planning and management公共安全规划与管理

NoteScope of this section

The discussion below is under 500 words and is written to separate three things that are routinely conflated: what the analysis establishes, what it suggests but cannot establish, and what would require additional data. No causal claim is made from these data.

Note本节范围

以下讨论(英文版)控制在 500 词以内,写法上刻意区分三件常被混为一谈的事:分析 确立了什么、分析提示但无法确立什么,以及哪些结论需要额外数据才能得出。 本报告不从这些数据中提出任何因果论断。

What the analysis establishes. Detection intensity in Pulang Pisau is extremely uneven (roughly 39-fold variation around the mean) and concentrated in a band present on all 8 days. The median detection lies 559 m from a mapped canal against 1,119 m for a random location, while being 35% further from natural rivers than chance, a dissociation that survives multivariate adjustment. That measured geography does not reproduce the observed spatial structure; a model adding compact clusters of about 2.1 km does. And detections close in space are also close in time.

分析确立了什么。 Pulang Pisau 的探测强度极不均匀(围绕均值约 39 倍的变化幅度)并集中在一条在全部 8 天都存在的条带内。探测点到已制图运河的 中位距为 559 m, 而随机位置为 1,119 m; 同时探测点比随机位置更远离天然河流 35% 。这一分离在多变量调整后依然成立。已测得的地理条件无法再现观测到的空间结构; 而在其上加入约 2.1 km 的紧凑簇群后可以。并且, 空间上靠近的探测点在时间上也靠近。

Where this points, operationally. Four implications follow directly.

Targeting is two questions, not one. Pandih Batu has the highest rate per unit area (1465 per 1,000 km², about 5× the regency average) and is small enough for saturation coverage. Sebangau Kuala carries 36% of all detections over a far larger area, and needs mobile rather than fixed capacity. Rate and share should not be collapsed into one ranking (§ 5.4).

Match the intervention to the estimated scale. The fitted cluster scale is about 2.1 km, with ~95% of a cluster’s detections within 4.3 km. Interventions with that footprint (canal blocking, village-level fire-free agreements, small mobile crews) are dimensionally appropriate; regency-wide measures are not.

Allocate dynamically, not only spatially. Space–time dependence means location alone is an incomplete rule. Same-day detections within 1 km occur 1.52× as often as chance, and the excess decays over a few days (§ 6.6). This supports escalating coverage around a confirmed detection for a defined window, rather than allocating on last season’s map alone.

Hydrology is the candidate lever. The canal–river dissociation discriminates between mechanisms: generic proximity to water does not predict fire, proximity to engineered drainage does. That is consistent with the peat-hydrology literature and with canal blocking as mitigation (Ritzema et al., 2014; Sloan et al., 2022).

这在操作上指向什么。 直接得出四点启示。

瞄准是两个问题,不是一个。 Pandih Batu 单位面积发生率最高 (1465 个/千 km²,约为全县均值的 5×), 且面积小到足以做饱和覆盖。Sebangau Kuala 则在大得多的面积上承载了全部 探测的 36%,需要的是机动而非固定力量。 发生率与占比不应被压缩成同一个排名(§ 5.4)。

让干预措施匹配估计出的尺度。 拟合的簇群尺度约 2.1 km,一个簇约 95% 的探测落在 4.3 km 以内。具有该作用范围的措施(运河 封堵、村级无火协议、小型机动队)在尺度上是匹配的;全县一刀切的措施则不是。

要动态配置,而不只是空间配置。 时空依赖意味着仅凭位置是不完整的规则。1 km 内 同日的探测出现频率是随机情形的 1.52×,且这一超额在数天内 衰减(§ 6.6)。这支持在一次确认探测周围于限定时间窗内升级覆盖,而不是 只按上一季的地图配置。

水文是候选的抓手。 运河, 河流的分离能够区分机制:泛泛的「靠水」并不预测火, 靠近人工排水才预测火。这与泥炭水文文献一致,也与把运河封堵作为缓解手段的思路 一致 (Ritzema et al., 2014; Sloan et al., 2022)。

What the analysis suggests but cannot establish. That canals cause the concentration, and that the clusters represent fire spreading. The association is cross-sectional over eight days; drainage, accessibility, tenure and degraded land cover all co-vary, and an unmeasured covariate varying at a few kilometres would reproduce the cluster signature exactly. Neighbouring Maliku shares the Mega Rice Project history and had only 3 pixel-days, a contrast this analysis cannot explain, and which should temper any simple canal-to-fire reading.

What additional data would be needed. Peat depth and water-table monitoring; canal condition, including which channels are already blocked; land cover and tenure; and a multi-season archive. Evaluating whether blocking reduces fire requires a before–after or controlled comparison, which these data cannot provide.

分析提示但无法确立什么。 运河导致了这种集中,以及这些簇群代表火在蔓延。 该关联是八天的横断面关联;排水、可达性、土地权属与退化的土地覆盖全都共变,而任何 一个在数公里尺度上变化的未测协变量都会精确复现出同样的簇群特征。相邻的 Maliku 区有同样的百万公顷稻米工程历史,却只有 3 个像元-日。这一反差本分析无法解释, 也应当让任何「运河直接导致火」的简单读法有所收敛。

还需要哪些额外数据。 泥炭深度与地下水位监测;运河状况,包括哪些渠道已被封堵; 土地覆盖与权属;以及跨季档案。要评估封堵是否真的减少火灾,需要前后对照或有对照组的 比较,而这些数据无法提供。

11 Limitations局限

The limitations below are ordered by how much they should change a reader’s confidence, not by how easy they are to state.

以下局限按「应当在多大程度上改变读者的信心」排序,而不是按「陈述起来是否容易」 排序。

11.1 1. The observation process, not fire, sets the temporal signal1. 决定时间信号的是观测过程,而不是火

This is the most serious limitation and it is demonstrated rather than suspected. Only 8.8% of fire-affected pixel-days were detected by all three VIIRS satellites; one day in eight has no daytime overpass at all; and near-identical sensors disagree by a factor of more than ten on individual days (§ 3.7). Consequences:

  • No claim is made about fire-activity trend. The daily counts in § 5.1 describe a fire–observation compound.
  • All intensities are lower bounds. A fire under cloud contributes nothing.
  • The bias is not uniform. Cloud is spatially autocorrelated, so if cloud frequency differs systematically between the canal-dense south and the forested north, the intensity contrast between them is biased too. Nothing in these data bounds that bias.

The space–time result is much more robust to this, because the Knox test conditions on the observed locations and dates rather than modelling them, and independent thinning leaves the pair-correlation function unchanged (A. Baddeley et al., 2015). That is why the space–time finding is stated more confidently than anything else in this report. It does not rescue the spatial cluster scale, because cloud is not independent thinning and a cloud-hole a few kilometres across would mimic a fire cluster a few kilometres across.

这是最严重的局限,而且它是被证明出来的,不是被猜测的。过火像元-日中只有 8.8% 被三颗 VIIRS 卫星全部探测到;八天中有一天完全没有白天过境;而近乎相同的传感器在 个别日期上的分歧可达十倍以上(§ 3.7)。后果:

  • 本报告不对火灾活动的趋势提出任何论断。 § 5.1 中的逐日计数描述的是 一个「火, 观测」复合体。
  • 所有强度都只是下界。 云层下的火贡献为零。
  • 偏差并不均匀。 云具有空间自相关,因此若运河密集的南部与森林覆盖的北部云频率 存在系统性差异,两者之间的强度对比也会有偏。这些数据无法界定该偏差的范围。

时空结果对此稳健得多,因为 Knox 检验以观测到的位置与日期为条件,而不是对它们 建模;并且独立抽稀不改变对相关函数 (A. Baddeley et al., 2015)。这正是本报告中时空发现的陈述 语气比其他任何结论都更有信心的原因。但它并不能挽救空间簇群尺度,因为云不是 独立抽稀,而一个数公里宽的云洞会伪装成一个数公里宽的火簇。

11.2 2. Eight days is not a fire season2. 八天不等于一个火季

The window is 8 local days at the peak of the dry season. It therefore describes one burning episode, and cannot speak to seasonality, inter-annual variation, El Niño sensitivity (Field et al., 2016), or whether September 2026 was unusual. The authenticated acquisition script removes this limitation without changing any other file, and doing so is the single highest-value extension of this work.

窗口是旱季峰值期的 8 个当地日。因此它描述的是一次燃烧事件,无法就 季节性、年际变化、厄尔尼诺敏感性 (Field et al., 2016),或 2026 年 9 月是否异常发表意见。 需认证的获取脚本可以在不改动任何其他文件的前提下解除这一局限,而这么做正是本工作 单项价值最高的扩展。

11.3 3. A detection is not a fire, and an event is not an ignition3. 一次探测不是一场火,一个事件也不是一次点火

The analysis unit is a 375 m pixel-day. It over-counts large fires (many pixels) and under-counts short ones (invisible between overpasses). The event-level reconstruction in § 2.3 was intended to recover something closer to ignitions, but at this fire density single-linkage chaining merged 23% of all pixel-days into one component. Event counts are therefore reported as indicative only, and the number of fires in Pulang Pisau in this period is not estimated.

分析单元是 375 m 的像元-日。它高估大火(多个像元),低估短时火(在两次 过境之间不可见)。§ 2.3 中的事件级重建本意是恢复更接近点火的量,但在本例 的火密度下,单连接链式合并把全部像元-日的 23% 并进了一个连通分量。 因此事件计数仅作指示性报告,本报告不估计该期间 Pulang Pisau 的火灾数量。

11.4 4. The spatial first/second-order decomposition is not identifiable4. 空间一阶/二阶分解不可识别

This is not a caveat on a result; it is a limit on what any single-realisation study of this kind can conclude, and § 6.3 demonstrates it rather than asserting it. Tested against a kernel-based inhomogeneous Poisson null, the same data give \(p =\) 0.080 at \(\sigma_\lambda\) = 2 km and \(p =\) 0.0025 at 10 km, with the \(p\)-value tracking the null’s flexibility monotonically.

Three consequences, stated precisely:

  • No claim is made that the pattern “is clustered” in an absolute sense. That phrase has no bandwidth-free meaning here.
  • The claims that are made rest on nulls with few parameters: measured geography does not reproduce the observed \(L(r)\) (§ 7.4), and a trend-plus-Thomas model does.
  • The fitted cluster scale of 2,140 m should be read as a compact description of a few-kilometre correlation structure, not as evidence that fires physically propagate over that distance. An unmeasured covariate varying at the same scale would produce an identical signature.

这不是对某个结果的附带说明,而是对任何此类单次实现研究所能得出结论的限制, 而且 § 6.3 是展示了它,而不是断言它。在基于核的非齐次泊松零模型下, 同一批数据在 \(\sigma_\lambda\) = 2 km 时给出 \(p =\) 0.080,在 10 km 时给出 \(p =\) 0.0025,\(p\) 值单调地追踪零模型的 灵活度。

由此有三点精确的推论:

  • 本报告不声称该模式在绝对意义上「是聚集的」。 在此处,这个说法脱离带宽就没有 意义。
  • 那些确实提出的论断,都建立在参数很少的零模型上:已测得的地理条件无法再现 观测到的 \(L(r)\)(§ 7.4),而「趋势 + Thomas」模型可以。
  • 拟合出的簇群尺度 2,140 m 应被读作对一个 数公里相关结构的紧凑描述,而不是火在该距离上物理传播的证据。任何在相同尺度上 变化的未测协变量都会产生完全相同的特征。

11.5 5. Covariates are proxies, and their completeness varies spatially5. 协变量只是代理变量,且其完备性在空间上不均匀

The drainage finding (§ 5.5, § 7) rests on OSM waterway=canal/drain/ditch. Three caveats follow:

  • It measures mapped canals, not drainage. Water-table depth, peat depth and canal condition (whether a channel still drains or has been blocked) are all unobserved. Peat depth in particular is a strong known control on fire severity (Konecny et al., 2016) and is absent here.
  • OSM completeness is not spatially uniform, and is plausibly better near settlements and roads. If canals are better mapped where people are, and people are where fires are lit, part of the canal effect could be a mapping artefact. The river covariate partially guards against this (rivers are mapped at least as completely as ditches, and the effect there runs in the opposite direction), but it is not a complete control.
  • Land cover is missing entirely. Whether a location is degraded scrub, smallholding, oil palm or intact swamp forest is the most obvious omitted variable, and it is correlated with canal proximity.

排水相关的发现(§ 5.5、§ 7)建立在 OSM 的 waterway=canal/drain/ditch 之上。由此有三点告示:

  • 它度量的是「已制图的运河」,不是「排水」。 地下水位深度、泥炭深度,以及运河 状况(某条渠道是否仍在排水、还是已被封堵)全都未被观测。其中泥炭深度尤其是已知 的火灾严重度强控制因素 (Konecny et al., 2016),而此处完全缺失。
  • OSM 的完备性在空间上并不均匀,而且很可能在居民点与道路附近更好。如果运河在 有人的地方被制图得更完整,而火又是在有人的地方被点燃,那么运河效应的一部分可能 是制图假象。河流协变量对此有部分防护(河流的制图完整度至少不低于沟渠,而其 效应方向相反)但这不是完整的对照。
  • 土地覆盖完全缺失。 某个位置是退化灌丛、小农地、油棕还是完整沼泽林,是最明显 的遗漏变量,而且它与运河邻近度相关。

11.6 6. Statistical caveats that would change reported uncertainty, not direction6. 会改变所报告不确定性、但不改变方向的统计性告示

  • Berman and KS \(p\)-values are anti-conservative. Both assume independent points; the points are demonstrably not independent (§ 7.4), so the effective sample size is far below 2,715 (§ 5.5).
  • ppm standard errors are understated for the same reason, which is why coefficients are read for sign and magnitude and the clustering is modelled explicitly in kppm (§ 7).
  • A non-rejection is not a confirmation. The Thomas process was not rejected (\(p =\) 0.69), but other cluster processes (a log-Gaussian Cox process, for instance) would very likely fit comparably. The model is one adequate description, not the identified one.
  • Isotropy is doubtful. Canals form an oriented grid and fire plausibly spreads along them, so an isotropic \(g(r)\) would understate along-canal correlation and overstate across-canal correlation. A directional analysis would test this and was not performed.
  • The Monte-Carlo \(p\)-value floor is 0.005 for the envelope tests and 0.001 for the 999-permutation tests. Values at the floor mean “no simulation was as extreme”, not a precise probability.
  • Berman 与 KS 检验的 \(p\) 值是反保守的。 两者都假定点相互独立;而这些点可证 地并不独立(§ 7.4),因此有效样本量远低于 2,715 (§ 5.5)。
  • ppm 的标准误被低估,原因相同;这正是为什么系数只按符号与量级解读,而聚集 性则在 kppm 中显式建模(§ 7)。
  • 不拒绝不等于证实。 Thomas 过程未被拒绝(\(p =\) 0.69),但其他聚集过程(例如对数高斯 Cox 过程)很可能拟合得同样好。该模型是一个充分的描述,而不是被识别出来的那一个。
  • 各向同性可疑。 运河构成有方向的格网,火很可能沿其蔓延,因此各向同性的 \(g(r)\) 会低估沿运河方向的相关、高估跨运河方向的相关。方向性分析可以检验这一点,但本报告 未做。
  • 蒙特卡洛 \(p\) 值的下限在包络检验中为 0.005,在 999 次置换检验 中为 0.001。落在下限上的取值意味着「没有一次模拟达到同样极端」,而不是一个精确的 概率值。

11.7 7. Window and boundary effects7. 窗口与边界效应

The window is administrative, not hydrological, so it cuts the fire process arbitrarily; its southern edge is a coast, where edge correction assumes a process that does not exist offshore and therefore over-corrects coastal intensity upward. Shrinking the window by 5 and 10 km left the second-order conclusion unchanged (§ 6.5), which addresses the concern for interaction but not for the intensity surface.

该窗口是行政性的、而非水文性的,因此它任意地切割了火灾过程;其南缘为海岸,而边界 校正假定过程在离岸处仍然存在,因此会把沿海强度向上过度校正。把窗口内缩 5 km 与 10 km 后二阶结论未变(§ 6.5),这消除了对交互结论的担忧,但没有 消除对强度面的担忧。

11.8 8. What this study cannot say at all8. 本研究完全无法回答的问题

For clarity about scope, the following are outside the reach of these data and are not claimed anywhere in this report: the cause of any individual fire; who lit it; whether canal blocking reduces fire (a causal claim requiring before–after or controlled comparison); smoke exposure or health outcomes; area burned or emissions; and any forecast of future fire.

为明确研究范围,以下内容超出这些数据的能力,本报告任何地方都未作此类论断:任何 单场火的成因;是谁点的;运河封堵是否减少火灾(这是一个需要前后对照或有对照组 比较的因果论断);烟霾暴露或健康结局;过火面积或排放量;以及对未来火灾的任何预测。

12.1 How to reproduce this report如何复现本报告

The repository is a self-contained Quarto project. From a clean clone:

本仓库是一个自包含的 Quarto 项目。从一份干净的克隆开始:

# 1. Acquire the data (choose ONE route)
#    Route A - open 7-day FIRMS files, no credentials needed. Note that this
#    returns whatever the most recent seven days happen to be, so re-running it
#    today will NOT reproduce the September 2026 window analysed here.
Rscript scripts/01b_assemble_public7d.R

#    Route B - authenticated FIRMS Area API, arbitrary date range. This is the
#    route that reproduces (or extends) the exact window.
export FIRMS_MAP_KEY=<your key>          # or write it to .firms_key
Rscript scripts/01_download_firms.R 2026-09-04 2026-09-11

# 2. Boundaries and contextual layers
Rscript scripts/02_osm_context.R

# 3. Preparation and analysis
Rscript scripts/03_prepare.R
Rscript scripts/04_covariates.R
Rscript scripts/05_firstorder.R
Rscript scripts/05b_stkde.R
Rscript scripts/06_secondorder.R
Rscript scripts/07_valueadded.R

# 4. Render the report and the executive summary
quarto render
NoteA note on exact reproducibility of the data

The open 7-day FIRMS files are a rolling window: they always contain the last seven days. The raw CSV actually used here is committed to the repository (data/raw/firms_pulangpisau_2026-09-04_2026-09-11.csv), so steps 2–4 reproduce every number in this report exactly. Step 1 is documented so that the acquisition is transparent and so that the analysis can be re-run over a different or longer window, not because re-running it would return the same records.

Note关于数据可精确复现性的说明

开放的 7 日 FIRMS 文件是一个滚动窗口:它始终只包含最近七天。本研究实际使用的原始 CSV 已提交进仓库(data/raw/firms_pulangpisau_2026-09-04_2026-09-11.csv),因此 步骤 2–4 可以精确复现本报告中的每一个数字。步骤 1 之所以写出来,是为了让数据 获取过程透明、并让分析能在不同或更长的窗口上重跑,而不是因为重跑它会返回相同的 记录。

12.3 Caching policy缓存策略

Monte-Carlo envelopes dominate the runtime of this analysis. They are wrapped in a small helper so that the code that ran stays visible in the report while repeated renders do not repeat the computation:

蒙特卡洛包络占据了本分析的绝大部分运行时间。它们被包在一个小助手函数里,使得 实际运行过的代码仍然显示在报告中,同时重复渲染不会重复计算:

Code 
# =============================================================================
# R/utils.R  -- shared helpers for the technical report and the analysis scripts
# Take-home Exercise 1 | ISSS626
# =============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(ggplot2)
})

# ---- Reproducible caching ---------------------------------------------------
# Monte-Carlo envelopes and point-process fits are the expensive part of this
# analysis. `cache_rds()` evaluates an expression once, stores the result, and
# returns the stored object on subsequent renders. The *code that ran remains
# visible in the report*, so the cache only removes recomputation, not
# transparency. Delete data/cache/ to force a full recomputation.
CACHE_DIR <- "data/cache"
dir.create(CACHE_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cache_rds <- function(name, expr, refresh = getOption("th1.refresh", FALSE)) {
  f <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, paste0(name, ".rds"))
  if (file.exists(f) && !refresh) return(readRDS(f))
  t0  <- Sys.time()
  val <- force(expr)
  saveRDS(val, f)
  message(sprintf("[cache] computed %-28s %.1fs", name,
                  as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))))
  val
}

# ---- Presentation -----------------------------------------------------------
# One typographic system for every statistical graphic, so the report reads as
# a single document rather than a pile of default plots.
PAL <- list(
  fire   = "#b91c1c", fire_l = "#f97316", fire_xl = "#fed7aa",
  water  = "#0e7490", grey   = "#57534e", grey_l = "#d6d3d1",
  env    = "#cbd5e1", theo   = "#1e293b", ok = "#15803d"
)

theme_th <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.05),
                                     margin = margin(b = 2)),
      plot.subtitle   = element_text(colour = PAL$grey, size = rel(0.88),
                                     margin = margin(b = 9)),
      plot.caption    = element_text(colour = PAL$grey, size = rel(0.74),
                                     hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 9)),
      axis.title      = element_text(size = rel(0.86)),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.28, colour = "#e7e5e4"),
      strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(0.85)),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.key.height = unit(0.4, "cm"),
      legend.title    = element_text(size = rel(0.82)),
      legend.text     = element_text(size = rel(0.78)),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.caption.position = "plot"
    )
}

# Envelope plots recur ~10 times; one function keeps them identical and keeps
# the axis labelling honest (distance in km, function value in km^2 for K).
plot_env <- function(e, title, subtitle = NULL, caption = NULL,
                     xlab = "Distance r (km)", ylab = NULL,
                     scale_x = 1000, scale_y = 1, ylab_default = "Summary function",
                     obs_lab = "Observed", theo_lab = "Null expectation") {
  d <- as.data.frame(e)
  d$r <- d$r / scale_x
  yy  <- c("obs", "mmean", "theo", "lo", "hi")
  for (v in intersect(yy, names(d))) d[[v]] <- d[[v]] / scale_y
  ref <- if ("mmean" %in% names(d)) "mmean" else "theo"
  ggplot(d, aes(r)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi, fill = "env"), alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_line(aes(y = .data[[ref]], colour = "theo"), linewidth = 0.5,
              linetype = "22") +
    geom_line(aes(y = obs, colour = "obs"), linewidth = 0.85) +
    scale_fill_manual(NULL, values = c(env = PAL$env),
                      labels = "Global envelope (α = 0.01)") +
    scale_colour_manual(NULL, values = c(obs = PAL$fire, theo = PAL$theo),
                        labels = c(obs = obs_lab, theo = theo_lab),
                        breaks = c("obs", "theo")) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, caption = caption,
         x = xlab, y = ylab %||% ylab_default) +
    theme_th()
}

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a

# Envelope plots for L-type functions are far easier to read when CENTRED on
# the reference curve: deviations then appear as departures from a horizontal
# zero line instead of as two nearly-parallel rising curves. The y axis becomes
# "excess L", in metres, which for an L function has a direct reading -- the
# extra radius over which the observed pattern packs the same number of
# neighbours as the reference process.
env_centred <- function(e, scale_x = 1000) {
  d <- as.data.frame(e)
  ref <- if ("mmean" %in% names(d)) d$mmean else d$theo
  data.frame(r = d$r / scale_x, ref = ref,
             obs = d$obs - ref, lo = d$lo - ref, hi = d$hi - ref)
}

plot_env_centred <- function(e, title, subtitle = NULL, caption = NULL,
                             ylab = "Observed L(r) − reference (m)",
                             xlab = "Distance r (km)",
                             ref_lab = "Reference process",
                             obs_lab = "Observed",
                             band_lab = "Global envelope (α = 0.01)",
                             annotate_exceed = TRUE) {
  d <- env_centred(e)
  out <- which(d$obs > d$hi | d$obs < d$lo)
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(r)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi, fill = "band"), alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "22", colour = PAL$theo,
               linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_line(aes(y = obs, colour = "obs"), linewidth = 0.9) +
    scale_fill_manual(NULL, values = c(band = PAL$env), labels = band_lab) +
    scale_colour_manual(NULL, values = c(obs = PAL$fire), labels = obs_lab) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, caption = caption,
         x = xlab, y = ylab) +
    theme_th()
  if (annotate_exceed && length(out)) {
    p <- p + annotate("rect", xmin = d$r[min(out)], xmax = d$r[max(out)],
                      ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = PAL$fire, alpha = 0.05)
  }
  p
}

# How far outside the envelope the observed curve strays, as a compact record
# that can be tabulated across bandwidths, units and windows.
env_summary <- function(e) {
  d <- env_centred(e)
  out <- which(d$obs > d$hi | d$obs < d$lo)
  above <- which(d$obs > d$hi); below <- which(d$obs < d$lo)
  list(n_out = length(out),
       pct_out = 100 * length(out) / nrow(d),
       r_first = if (length(out)) d$r[min(out)] else NA_real_,
       r_last  = if (length(out)) d$r[max(out)] else NA_real_,
       direction = if (length(above) > length(below)) "above (clustered)"
                   else if (length(below) > 0) "below (inhibited)" else "inside",
       max_excess = if (length(out)) max(d$obs[out] - d$hi[out]) else NA_real_)
}

# ---- Cartography ------------------------------------------------------------
# All maps in this report are drawn with ggplot2 + ggspatial rather than a
# mixture of plotting systems, so that typography, colour and legend treatment
# are identical across statistical graphics and maps.
theme_map <- function(base_size = 11) {
  theme_th(base_size) +
    theme(
      axis.text        = element_blank(),
      axis.title       = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks       = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.2, colour = "#f0efee"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#fcfcfb", colour = NA),
      panel.border     = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "#e7e5e4",
                                      linewidth = 0.4),
      legend.position  = "right",
      legend.key.width = unit(0.32, "cm"),
      legend.key.height= unit(1.0, "cm")
    )
}

# A spatstat `im` carries its values in a [ny, nx] matrix whose first row is the
# LOWEST y. as.data.frame.im already resolves that correctly, so it is used
# rather than hand-rolled matrix flipping; NA cells (outside the window) are
# dropped so geom_raster leaves them blank.
im_df <- function(im, value_name = "value", scale = 1) {
  d <- as.data.frame(im)
  names(d) <- c("x", "y", value_name)
  d[[value_name]] <- d[[value_name]] * scale
  d[!is.na(d[[value_name]]), ]
}

# Sequential ramp used for every intensity surface, so that two density maps in
# this report are always comparable at a glance.
scale_fill_fire <- function(name = expression(paste("per ", km^2)), ...) {
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    name   = name,
    colours = c("#fffbf5", "#fee9c8", "#fdbb6f", "#f97c31",
                "#dc4a1f", "#a81c0c", "#6b0d05"),
    na.value = NA, ...)
}

# Compact number formatting used throughout the prose.
n_fmt <- function(x, d = 0) formatC(x, format = "f", big.mark = ",", digits = d)
km    <- function(x, d = 1) paste0(formatC(x / 1000, format = "f", digits = d), " km")
# Vectorised, because several tables format a whole column of p-values at once.
pv <- function(p) {
  vapply(p, function(x) {
    if (is.na(x)) return("NA")
    if (x < 0.001) return("< 0.001")
    formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 3)
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

# spatstat's envelope-based tests return `statistic` as a one-row DATA FRAME
# (the statistic plus its rank among the simulations), not the named numeric an
# htest normally carries. This extracts the statistic itself in either case.
stat_of <- function(test) {
  st <- test$statistic
  if (is.data.frame(st)) return(unname(st[[1]]))
  unname(st[1])
}

# A single place to describe a Monte-Carlo test result in words, so that no
# p-value in the report is reported without its null model.
mc_line <- function(test, null_label) {
  sprintf("%s = %s, p %s (%d simulations of %s)",
          if (grepl("Diggle", test$method)) "DCLF u" else "MAD",
          formatC(unname(test$statistic), format = "g", digits = 4),
          pv(test$p.value),
          test$parameter[["nsim"]] %||% NA_integer_, null_label)
}

Deleting data/cache/ forces a full recomputation; because set.seed(1234) is set once at the top of every script, the recomputed values are identical.

删除 data/cache/ 会强制完全重算;由于每个脚本开头都设定了一次 set.seed(1234),重算得到的数值完全相同。

每个脚本的完整、未经编辑的源码,在渲染时从磁盘插入,因此不可能与实际运行的版本 产生偏移。

Code 
# =============================================================================
# 01_download_firms.R
# Take-home Exercise 1 | ISSS626 Geospatial Analytics and Applications
#
# PURPOSE
#   Acquire NASA FIRMS active-fire detections for the Pulang Pisau study area
#   for the 2026 observation period, via the FIRMS Area API.
#
# WHY A SCRIPT (AND NOT AN INLINE CHUNK IN THE REPORT)
#   The FIRMS Area API requires a personal MAP_KEY and is rate limited.
#   Acquisition is therefore separated from analysis so that the technical
#   report can be re-rendered offline from the cached raw CSVs, while the
#   acquisition step remains fully documented and reproducible.
#
# AUTHENTICATION
#   Obtain a free MAP_KEY at https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/api/map_key/
#   Supply it in ONE of the following ways (checked in this order):
#     1. environment variable  FIRMS_MAP_KEY
#     2. a one-line file       .firms_key   (git-ignored)
#
# USAGE
#   Rscript scripts/01_download_firms.R [start_date] [end_date]
#   e.g. Rscript scripts/01_download_firms.R 2026-01-01 2026-09-11
# =============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(httr); library(readr); library(dplyr); library(purrr); library(glue)
})

# ---- 0. Parameters ----------------------------------------------------------

args       <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
START_DATE <- if (length(args) >= 1) as.Date(args[1]) else as.Date("2026-01-01")
END_DATE   <- if (length(args) >= 2) as.Date(args[2]) else Sys.Date() - 1

# Study-area bounding box (WGS84), = Pulang Pisau Regency bbox buffered by
# ~0.15 deg (~17 km) so that (a) points just outside the regency are available
# for boundary-sensitivity checks, and (b) the exact administrative clip is
# performed later, in the analysis, rather than being baked into the download.
BBOX <- c(west = 113.43, south = -3.62, east = 114.50, north = -1.39)

# Sensors. VIIRS 375 m is the primary instrument family for this study:
#   VIIRS_SNPP_*  Suomi-NPP   (375 m, operational since 2012)  -> PRIMARY
#   VIIRS_NOAA20_NRT / VIIRS_NOAA21_NRT                        -> sensitivity
#   MODIS_*       Terra/Aqua  (1 km, longest record)            -> sensitivity
# "_SP" = Standard Processing (science quality, includes the `type` flag);
# "_NRT" = Near Real-Time (last ~2-3 months, no `type` flag).
SOURCES <- c("VIIRS_SNPP_SP",   "VIIRS_SNPP_NRT",
             "VIIRS_NOAA20_NRT","VIIRS_NOAA21_NRT",
             "MODIS_SP",        "MODIS_NRT")

CHUNK_DAYS <- 10L   # hard maximum accepted by the FIRMS Area API
OUT_DIR    <- "data/raw/firms_chunks"
dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---- 1. Resolve the MAP_KEY -------------------------------------------------

get_map_key <- function() {
  k <- Sys.getenv("FIRMS_MAP_KEY", unset = "")
  if (nzchar(k)) return(trimws(k))
  if (file.exists(".firms_key")) {
    k <- trimws(readLines(".firms_key", warn = FALSE)[1])
    if (nzchar(k)) return(k)
  }
  stop("No FIRMS MAP_KEY found. Set env var FIRMS_MAP_KEY or create .firms_key\n",
       "Request one (free) at https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/api/map_key/",
       call. = FALSE)
}
MAP_KEY <- get_map_key()

# ---- 2. Interrogate data availability --------------------------------------
# Each FIRMS source exposes a different valid date range (SP lags real time by
# ~2-3 months; NRT covers only the recent window). Querying availability first
# avoids wasted requests and lets us document exactly which sensor-product
# supplied each part of the time series.

availability <- function() {
  u <- glue("https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/api/data_availability/csv/{MAP_KEY}/all")
  r <- GET(u, timeout(60))
  stop_for_status(r)
  txt <- content(r, "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
  if (grepl("Invalid MAP_KEY", txt, fixed = TRUE)) stop("FIRMS rejected the MAP_KEY.", call. = FALSE)
  read_csv(txt, show_col_types = FALSE)
}

avail <- availability()
message("\n== FIRMS data availability ==")
print(as.data.frame(avail))
write_csv(avail, "data/raw/firms_data_availability.csv")

# ---- 3. Chunked download ----------------------------------------------------

fetch_chunk <- function(source, from, n_days) {
  dest <- file.path(OUT_DIR, glue("{source}_{from}_{n_days}d.csv"))
  if (file.exists(dest) && file.info(dest)$size > 0) return(dest)  # cache hit

  u <- glue("https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/api/area/csv/{MAP_KEY}/{source}/",
            "{BBOX['west']},{BBOX['south']},{BBOX['east']},{BBOX['north']}/",
            "{n_days}/{from}")

  for (attempt in 1:4) {                     # simple backoff: API is rate limited
    r <- try(GET(u, timeout(120)), silent = TRUE)
    if (!inherits(r, "try-error") && status_code(r) == 200) {
      txt <- content(r, "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
      if (grepl("Invalid", substr(txt, 1, 40))) {
        warning(glue("{source} {from}: {substr(txt,1,80)}")); return(NA_character_)
      }
      writeLines(txt, dest); return(dest)
    }
    Sys.sleep(5 * attempt)
  }
  warning(glue("Failed after retries: {source} {from}")); NA_character_
}

# Build the (source, chunk-start, length) request grid, restricted to each
# source's advertised availability window.
starts <- seq(START_DATE, END_DATE, by = glue("{CHUNK_DAYS} days"))
grid <- map_dfr(SOURCES, function(src) {
  row <- avail[avail[[1]] == src, ]
  if (nrow(row) == 0) { message(glue("  - {src}: not advertised; skipped")); return(NULL) }
  lo <- as.Date(row$min_date[1]); hi <- as.Date(row$max_date[1])
  tibble(source = src, from = starts) |>
    mutate(n_days = pmin(CHUNK_DAYS, as.integer(END_DATE - from) + 1L)) |>
    filter(from >= lo, from <= hi, n_days > 0)
})

message(glue("\n== Requesting {nrow(grid)} chunks ({length(unique(grid$source))} sources) =="))
grid$file <- pmap_chr(list(grid$source, grid$from, grid$n_days), fetch_chunk)

# ---- 4. Combine -------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunks are concatenated per sensor family. Columns differ between VIIRS
# (bright_ti4/bright_ti5) and MODIS (brightness/bright_t31) and between SP
# (has `type`) and NRT (no `type`), so binding is done with type-tolerant
# coercion and the provenance of every row is retained.

read_chunk <- function(f, src) {
  if (is.na(f)) return(NULL)
  d <- suppressWarnings(read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE,
                                 col_types = cols(.default = col_character())))
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(NULL)
  d$firms_source <- src
  d
}

all_rows <- map2(grid$file, grid$source, read_chunk) |> compact()
if (!length(all_rows)) stop("No FIRMS rows downloaded.", call. = FALSE)
fires <- bind_rows(all_rows)

out <- glue("data/raw/firms_pulangpisau_{START_DATE}_{END_DATE}.csv")
write_csv(fires, out)

message(glue("\n== Done: {nrow(fires)} raw detection records -> {out} =="))
print(fires |> count(firms_source, name = "records"))
Code 
# =============================================================================
# 01b_assemble_public7d.R
# Take-home Exercise 1 | ISSS626
#
# PURPOSE
#   Fallback / cross-check acquisition path. FIRMS publishes the most recent
#   7 days of detections as open regional CSVs that need no MAP_KEY:
#     https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/data/active_fire/<product>/csv/
#   This script harvests the "SouthEast_Asia" 7-day files for four sensors and
#   rewrites them into exactly the schema produced by 01_download_firms.R, so
#   that the downstream preparation and analysis code is identical whichever
#   acquisition route supplied the data.
#
#   Note the products differ: the 7-day open files are NRT only and therefore
#   carry no `type` flag (static-source / volcano / offshore classification).
#   That limitation is carried forward and reported in the quality assessment.
# =============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(readr); library(dplyr); library(glue)})

RAW <- "data/raw"; dir.create(RAW, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

PRODUCTS <- tibble::tribble(
  ~firms_source,        ~path,
  "VIIRS_SNPP_NRT",     "suomi-npp-viirs-c2/csv/SUOMI_VIIRS_C2_SouthEast_Asia_7d.csv",
  "VIIRS_NOAA20_NRT",   "noaa-20-viirs-c2/csv/J1_VIIRS_C2_SouthEast_Asia_7d.csv",
  "VIIRS_NOAA21_NRT",   "noaa-21-viirs-c2/csv/J2_VIIRS_C2_SouthEast_Asia_7d.csv",
  "MODIS_NRT",          "modis_c6_1/csv/MODIS_C6_1_SouthEast_Asia_7d.csv"
)
BASE <- "https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/data/active_fire"
BBOX <- c(west = 113.43, south = -3.62, east = 114.50, north = -1.39)

out <- purrr::pmap_dfr(PRODUCTS, function(firms_source, path) {
  dest <- file.path(RAW, basename(path))
  if (!file.exists(dest)) {
    message("downloading ", basename(path))
    utils::download.file(file.path(BASE, path), dest, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
  }
  d <- read_csv(dest, show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
  d$firms_source <- firms_source
  # Clip to the buffered study bbox at read time: the regional file covers all
  # of South-East Asia and is ~5 MB per sensor.
  d |> mutate(.lon = as.numeric(longitude), .lat = as.numeric(latitude)) |>
    filter(.lon >= BBOX["west"], .lon <= BBOX["east"],
           .lat >= BBOX["south"], .lat <= BBOX["north"]) |>
    select(-.lon, -.lat)
})

rng <- range(as.Date(out$acq_date))
dest <- glue("{RAW}/firms_pulangpisau_{rng[1]}_{rng[2]}.csv")
write_csv(out, dest)
message(glue("\n{nrow(out)} records, {rng[1]} to {rng[2]} -> {dest}"))
print(out |> count(firms_source, name = "records"))
print(out |> count(firms_source, acq_date) |> tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = firms_source, values_from = n))
